title: QoS rejection toast is gated behind a pipe selection, but the dial (right-click) never selects — a rejected dial cycle on an unselected pipe is silent
location: app/main.odin:494 (toast draw, nested in the sel_pipe block) / app/main.odin:198-208 (right-click branch) / app/main.odin:388-393 (rejection recorded)
detail: Right-click cycles the dial without selecting, so an E6 rejection (last_reject set) lands while sel_pipe < 0 and the toast — nested inside the selection block — is never drawn, contradicting the code's own 'never silent' comment. The readout also doesn't follow an unselected-pipe dial cycle.
recommended_fix: Draw the rejection toast outside the `if app.sel_pipe >= 0` block, or select the hit pipe in the right-click branch before cycle_emphasis.

title: intent_apply_tick_raw is a third copy of the floor(at_ms*hz/1000)+1 apply-tick formula
location: harness/run.odin:85 (new helper) vs harness/demo.odin:341 intent_apply_tick and harness/demo.odin:355 demolish_apply_tick (existing helpers)
detail: The same edit-fast-path convention (floor + 1) now exists at three sites; a future timing-convention change (e.g. round-up) must be made in three places. The new proc's at_ms/raw signature only differs by taking the pre-parsed ms.
recommended_fix: Extract one shared helper (e.g. `apply_tick_from_ms(at_ms: i64, logic_hz: i32) -> u64` in demo.odin) and have all three intent types call it.

title: OS window title still reads 'v2 story 1.2' while the HUD title was updated to 3.2 in the same diff
location: app/main.odin:77 (InitWindow) vs app/main.odin:427 (draw_hud title, changed by this PR)
evidence: app/main.odin:77: "rl.InitWindow(WIN_W, WIN_H, "Packet Plumber — v2 story 1.2")". app/main.odin:427: "draw_text(app, "Packet Plumber — v2 story 3.2 (3-lane QoS + emphasis dial)", 12, 10, 22, p.ink)"
detail: This PR updated the in-HUD version banner to 3.2 but left the window title on its pre-existing 'story 1.2' string — a user-visible version inconsistency (stale since 1.4, but the diff touched the sibling line).
recommended_fix: Update the InitWindow title to "Packet Plumber — v2 story 3.2 (3-lane QoS + emphasis dial)" to match the HUD banner.
